authority: benchmark organization only; no real-agent, novelty, or universal theorem authority
matched_information_rule: Within each family, non-oracle primary comparators receive the same frozen factual world; the treatment changes how declared epistemic metadata is represented or used under the family protocol.

families.decision: which unknown interface feasibility is worth probing and whether to commit
families.hostile_or_null_control: uniform prior removes type-conditioned information while retaining the same VoI machinery
families.scope: frozen layered-DAG world with type-conditioned feasibility priors exposed as facts

families.decision: whether a previous failure receipt should be reopened after context changes
families.hostile_or_null_control: REOPEN_WASTEFUL regime where NOISE changes but relevant scope rarely changes
families.scope: two-regime receipt world; initial receipts only

families.decision: which uncertain resource edges should consume a limited verification budget before Pareto choice
families.hostile_or_null_control: same verification budget with untargeted random edge selection
families.scope: frozen interval world, verification budget B=4; not a full-front hypervolume theorem

families.decision: whether a scientific receipt remains valid after a transformation chain
families.hostile_or_null_control: deep evidence splices that preserve the final hop plus an honest-chain false-positive set
families.scope: constructed exact transport chains; not cryptographic security

families.decision: which observation should be acquired when some high-entropy facts cannot affect the decision
families.hostile_or_null_control: maximum-entropy decision-irrelevant decoy facts under an identical stopping rule
families.scope: frozen clause world; isolates next-experiment selection, not a general active-learning theorem

families.decision: whether evidence can be reused, requires remint, or should be rederived after representation edits
families.hostile_or_null_control: STALE_HOSTILE punishes naive carry-forward; REMINT_UNNECESSARY requires the typed method to tie rather than gain
families.primary_metric: mean utility, failure rate and remint count
families.scope: three frozen transport regimes; transport-rule soundness by construction
